description: Publish a distribution's branch to the CDN as a new version. Live apps using the Translatize OTA SDK pick it up on their next refresh, so this changes what end users see, and everything published is PUBLIC. Only call it when the user has explicitly asked to publish, and pass confirm: true – without it nothing is published. Needs the developer role, and the distribution's branch must be in the token's allowed set (otherwise branch_not_allowed). Get the id from list_distributions.

confirm.description: Must be true: confirms the user explicitly asked to publish this release to end users.

name: publish_release
title: Publish OTA Release
